principles: Define the actual work and first-year outcomes for each role.
Apply one opportunity-specific evidence bar consistently to every version.
Use the resume only to decide whether to advance to a structured interview or practical work sample.
Retain open hard screens, work-sample questions, and reference checks after a resume passes.
Counter similarity and charisma bias by testing evidence, agency, collaboration, craft, and claim boundaries.

contract.scope: Every opportunity currently represented in the named public hiring-reader registry, including its expired benchmark.
contract.modeledReaderBasis: Public job descriptions, public organizational context, and the repository's public-safe opportunity records only.
contract.acceptanceQuestion: Under this explicitly fictionalized public-source lens, would this reader advance Jamie from resume review to a structured interview or practical work sample for this opportunity?
notEstablishedByPass: An actual named person reviewed, approved, endorsed, or would hire Jamie.
Jamie will receive an interview, offer, appointment, or final hiring decision.
Civil-service, authorization, reference, background, or other formal screens are satisfied.
A resume substitutes for a work sample, structured interview, reference check, or employer judgment.
